purpose: Prospectively collect point-in-time production Football AI and canonical market probabilities on the same future EPL fixtures without reading target outcomes, then evaluate the frozen production artifact against fair market on identical selected snapshots.

collection.market_decision: latest durably recorded pre-kickoff league_prediction_ledger row observed at collection time
collection.latest_row_policy: select latest eligible durable row first, then validate it fail-closed; never fall back to an older row when latest is invalid

point_in_time_guards.history_semantics: Europe/London local kickoff; known kickoff becomes usable only after kickoff + 4h; missing-time rows fail closed for current/previous local date

evaluation.row_selection: for each event_id, use exactly the row with the maximum market_snapshot_time_utc among rows carrying the frozen model hash; ties resolve by pair_key ascending; selection occurs before joining target outcomes

readiness_gate.gate_policy: do not read experiment target outcomes until both the wall-clock date and at least 100 frozen-selected event kickoffs plus the 6h maturity buffer have elapsed
readiness_gate.post_gate_settlement_requirement: after the gate opens, require at least 100 selected fixtures with canonical settled outcomes before computing primary metrics; otherwise report WAIT_RESULTS without a primary verdict

primary_decision_rule.PASS: both Brier and log-loss model-minus-market bootstrap 95% CI upper bounds are strictly below 0
primary_decision_rule.FAIL: both Brier and log-loss model-minus-market bootstrap 95% CI lower bounds are strictly above 0
primary_decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: all other combinations, including metric disagreement or confidence intervals crossing 0
